content: Root cause: The bug was caused by an incorrect initialization of the list of files in the `FS_ListFiles()` function, specifically related to the handling of the `numfiles` variable. The original implementation incorrectly allocated space for one extra file (nfiles + 1) instead of just the number of matching files (nfiles), leading to potential out-of-bounds access when filling the list. Additionally, there were issues with how the number of items was updated in the UI, which affected the behavior of the spin control when navigating through items. The patch corrected these issues by ensuring proper allocation and initialization of the file list and updating the relevant UI variables accordingly.
